name: lystbot
description: Read and update your LystBot lists, items and reminders from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Manage your LystBot lists and reminders right from ChatGPT. Read your own and shared lists, add and check off items, create new lists and set reminders. To connect, open the LystBot app, go to Settings → ChatGPT and enter the six-digit code. You can disconnect at any time in the app or in ChatGPT. Learn more at https://lystbot.com
defaultPrompt: Add milk to my shopping list.
Create a reminder for tomorrow at 9 AM.
